hints.explanation: In stories, werewolves change into wolves under a full moon.

hints.explanation: The Moon's gravity is the main cause of high tide.

lines.HIGH: At high tide, the sea reaches the top of its daily rise.
lines.MOON: The Moon's pull on the oceans is the main driver of tides.

lines.LEGO: LEGO calls its classic building piece a brick.
lines.WALL: Many walls are built from bricks.

lines.SHELL: Crabs grow by molting their shells.

hints.explanation: The Titanic sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg.

lines.SINK: Hitting an iceberg made the Titanic sink.
lines.TITANIC: The Titanic struck an iceberg on its maiden voyage.
